# Sirach Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 17 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_017_page_001.jpg

---

**17:1** The LORD made human beings from the dust of the earth, and he brings them back to it again.

**17:2** He gave them a numbered set of days, a fixed span of time, and authority over everything in the earth.

**17:3** He dressed them in strength like his own, and formed them in his own image.

**17:4** He put the fear of human beings into every living creature, and gave them dominion over animals and birds.

**17:5** He equipped them with the LORD's five gifts; and as a sixth gift, the mind; and as a seventh, reason — the one that makes sense of all the others.

**17:6** He shaped tongue and eyes for them, and gave them ears and a thinking heart.

**17:7** He filled them with knowledge and understanding, and let them see what is good and what is evil.

**17:8** He turned his eye toward their hearts to show them the greatness of his works —

**17:9** so that they would praise his holy name forever, and tell the world of the magnificence of what he has done.

**17:10** He set knowledge before them and gave them the law of life as their inheritance.

**17:11** He made an everlasting covenant with them and revealed his decrees to them.

**17:12** Their eyes saw the splendor of his majesty, their ears heard the glory of his voice.

**17:13** He said to them: "Stay away from every kind of injustice," and he gave each of them obligations toward their neighbor.

**17:14** Their ways are always in front of him; nothing can be hidden from his sight.

**17:15** Over every nation he set a ruler, but Israel is the LORD's own special portion.

**17:16** Everything they do stands before him like sunlight; his eyes are always on their ways.

**17:17** Nothing in their covenant is hidden from him; their wrongdoing stands open before the LORD.

**17:18** A person's generosity is like a signet ring before the LORD — he treasures their kindness like the apple of his eye.

**17:19** In time, he will rise up and repay them, returning their reward upon their heads.

**17:20** But to those who repent, he grants a new beginning; he lifts up those who are losing hope.

**17:21** Turn back to the LORD; let go of your sins; pray in his presence and make your offenses fewer.

**17:22** Return to the Most High; turn your back on wrongdoing; hate what he hates — deeply and completely.

**17:23** Who is left to praise the Most High in the world below? Only the living can give thanks.

**17:24** From the dead, praise stops as completely as if from nothing; but the one who is alive and well praises the LORD.

**17:25** How vast is the LORD's mercy, and his forgiveness for those who return to him!

**17:26** Human beings are not capable of everything — none of us lives forever.

**17:27** Is anything brighter than the sun? And yet it can be eclipsed. So human beings are capable of devising evil.

**17:28** He surveys the heights of the heavens; all human beings are dust and ashes.

**17:29** The LORD is vast in knowledge; he sees all things at all times and watches every human path.

**17:30** He has revealed none of his works in full; who could ever fully investigate his mighty deeds?

**17:31** The assembly of the Most High will see him; all things are held in check by his sovereign power.
